data.narrative:
Recursion Pharmaceuticals is a public-stage biotech company currently valued at $1.6B, having raised over $2B to date. The valuation assessment draws on a comparable universe of 11 peers in Biotech & Health—3 public companies (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private-stage firms spanning Series B through Series C, including Chai Discovery, New Limit, Freenome, Alto Neuroscience, and Eikon Therapeutics.

The peer-median method was applied across 5 same-sector comparables with similar valuation tiers, yielding a median implied valuation of $1.1B. The peer range spans $539M (Eikon Therapeutics, Series B) to $3.8B (Chai Discovery, Series C), reflecting stage and maturity variance within the cohort. Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales multiples—median 8.1x across the 3 public tickers—was not applicable, as Recursion's revenue was not disclosed.

The triangulated valuation range is $935M to $1.3B, centered at $1.1B median. The current $1.6B valuation sits above this range, suggesting either a premium to peer fundamentals or valuation uplift attributable to public-market status. Key uncertainties include Recursion's undisclosed revenue trajectory, pipeline advancement, and whether stage differences (public vs. late-stage private) warrant the valuation differential. The single-method result (peer-median only) limits confidence; revenue-based cross-validation remains infeasible without public disclosures.
